messages:
docs-bot: link-checker: 1 broken link detected in /docs/runtime/kv-cache.md -> https://models.example.com/legacy/model-info (HTTP 404)
Marta: Ugh, thanks bot. who owns the kv-cache doc nowadays?
Nik: that'd be me (runtime). I can take a look.
Marta: awesome — if it's a tiny fix can you open a PR and tag a reviewer? CI flagged it in the nightly sweep.
Nik: will do. likely just an external URL update + small anchor tweak. opening PR now.
Nik: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — updates external link, fixes anchor id, and adds a redirect for the old route. PTAL @Ben @Sam :eyes:
Ben: on it, should be quick. i'll review in ~30m.
Sam: quick thought — can we also add a redirect entry so existing shortlinks don't 404? something like:
```yaml
- from: /models/legacy/model-info
  to: /models/latest/model-info
  status: 302
```
Sam: if you add that to redirects.yaml in the same PR i'll approve.
Nik: added the redirect snippet to the PR (and adjusted frontmatter). ran local linkcheck and it passes for me.
Marta: thanks — any chance the deploy preview will show the new doc?
Nik: preview created by netlify in the PR checks, but noticed one unrelated staging image returned 403 — opened infra ticket in #eng-infra.
Ben: reviewed and left a tiny nit (trailing space). LGTM after nit.
Nik: fixed nit, pushed. CI link-check and netlify preview passing now.
docs-bot: link-checker: no failures on branch refs/pull/4123/head — all good :white_check_mark:
Marta: perfect. tagging the PR into the next docs sprint board. thanks everyone :party_parrot:
Ben: nice wrap-up.
Sam: thanks Nik!
Nik: np, closing thread once merged.
